grade.reasons: Complete self-contained HTML with @media mobile rules, full 6-component hover system on cards, Activate as gradient primary and Fund as ghost secondary throughout. Sample acts are labeled ('Sample acts shown for illustration'), sponsor attribution uses the subtle 'Made possible by [Sponsor]' format, and no metrics are invented. Voice is warm and direct with locked vocabulary (activate/fund, pre-funded, trusted nonprofit partner, 'Good is ready to happen', 'Most giving ends with a receipt. Gratitude ends with a result.'), no em dashes, no donation language, and correct colors and fonts. One minor note: the title tag uses an em dash, but that is browser metadata not brand copy, so the output is client-ready.
